name: advice-ledger-kit
description: Grade the grader: measure whether a recommendation engine's advice was taken and whether it turned out right. Exposure-aligned before/after windows, separate floors per window with machine-readable refusal codes instead of a verdict, symmetric propose/refute thresholds, and a two-judge divergence detector that reports engine-was-right and human-was-right separately. Zero-dependency, domain-agnostic TypeScript.
author: Lucas Kopietz
